name: EPIC 248753115
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 13.6 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,185 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.83 solar masses and 13.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,627 K at its surface.
